items.title: Top 3 AI Stocks To Watch In November 2026
items.summary: Vast sums are starting to chase the physical backbone of artificial intelligence as new LNG and power projects in Africa signal heavy long term investment in energy infrastructure. That kind of capital spending needs data handling, power distribution, and high performance computing gear. Investors watching this shift have a window to look at the “picks and shovels” of AI.
